A '''star''' was [[orbit]]ed by the [[planet]] [[Shili]]<ref name="Leia" /> in the [[Shili system]] in the [[Ehosiq sector]] of the [[Expansion Region]], specifically in grid square L-8 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Appendix" /> The [[star]] was nearly the same size, and had nearly the same properties, as [[Paucris Major's sun|that]] of the [[Paucris system]], and therefore had nearly identical ionization levels.<ref name="Leia" />

{{Star-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Shili's sun was first mentioned in ''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]'', a [[2017]] young-adult novel written by [[Claudia Gray]].<ref name="Leia" />
